context.content: I think OP is referring to systems different from Dropbox, OneDrive, etc. that are explicitly sold as cloud backup solutions. In those cases they do work differently. I think it's fine to use those (as long as you do your homework and use a reputable service), but it's still important to at least occasionally create your own "hard" backups onto ~~remote~~ removable media that you store away from your computer.
